parameters.name: n_minimum_points
parameters.description: Minimum number of points required per bin for a KDE to be computed.

parameters.name: aggregation_window_size
parameters.description: The size of the window used for aggregating bins.

parameters.name: memory_size
parameters.description: The size of the memory window for storing data points.

parameters.name: bandwidth_function
parameters.description: The function used for determining the bandwidth of the KDE.

parameters.name: weight_function
parameters.description: The function used for determining the weights of the data points in the KDE.

parameters.name: threshold_type
parameters.description: The type of thresholding to be applied for anomaly detection. Because timeeval want raw scores, this parameter is set to -1 by default.
